submission.justification: Mixture-G3 at 2.0 mm gap achieves the best time resolution (0.86 ns) among all tested combinations. It complies with environmental/safety requirements due to the planned closed-loop gas recirculation, is available from suppliers, and is compatible with the high-voltage and QA systems. All project requirements are satisfied.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 is explicitly listed as a candidate in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: The gas system must comply with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies.
requirements.evidence: All mixtures will use a closed-loop recirculation system with 90% recovery, minimizing emissions.
Gap of 2.0 mm is within the allowed 1-3 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: Simulation shows Mixture-G3 at 2.0 mm achieves the best time resolution (0.86 ns) among all options.
